bodyDescription: This delicious paté treat made with chicken and fish is a veritable delicacy for every cat!The natural ingredients are steamed so that the nutritious properties are well preserved. Cleaning and preparing the chicken and fish, filling cans and adding toppings are all done manually. This delicious gluten-free paté treat is a real treat for any cat that loves meat and fish !
